summary: Steel tower, 30 m, built 2016 per Alberta's wildfire register; a September 2023 news report used it as a reference point for a seven-hectare wildfire nearby.

staffing.status: observer on duty, generally April to October (Alberta's description of its 127 lookout sites)

access.note: Register lists the tower as active with drive access (ACCESS_MODE drive). No source describes public visits.

events.note: Register gives 2016 as the construction year for the steel tower.

News report dated 18 September 2023: a seven-hectare wildfire near the Saddle Hills forest tower was listed as being held. The report does not give the fire's exact location, so the link to this tower rests on the shared name.

notes_for_editor: Register record plus one 2023 news item. The news report names the Saddle Hills forest tower but gives no coordinates for the fire, so linking the fire to this tower rests on the shared name and area. The brief has no local_unit for this tower, so the story names no municipality. Brief lists access as closed; see corrections. Staffing text is Alberta's program-wide description, not a tower-specific record.
